adjustReputation(address,int32).notice: Adjust reputation after a settled payment. Called by the router only. Accepts the agent's owner address for backward compatibility with QorbitpayRouter.

deactivateAgent(bytes32).notice: ERC-8004: Deactivate an agent. Only callable by the agent's owner.

getAgent(bytes32).notice: ERC-8004: Returns the core identity fields for an agent by its agentId.

getAgentByOwner(address).notice: Look up an agent by owner address. Returns both the agentId and the full extended record. Returns (bytes32(0), empty record) if not registered.

getAgentRecord(bytes32).notice: Returns the full agent record including Qorbitpay extension fields.

isRegistered(address).notice: Returns true if the given owner address has a registered agent. Kept for backward compatibility with QorbitpayRouter.

listAgents(uint256,uint256).notice: Paginated agent discovery returning full extended records and their agentIds.

registerAgent((address,string,string,str.notice: Register an agent using an ERC-8004 AgentIdentity struct. Returns a unique bytes32 agentId derived from owner, name, and block.timestamp. `identity.registeredAt` is ignored — the contract stamps block.timestamp; `identity.active` is always set true.

setDilithiumPubKey(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Store the agent's Dilithium (ML-DSA-44) public key hash on-chain (owner only).

updateEndpoint(bytes32,string).notice: Update the service endpoint for an agent (owner only).

updateTrustScore(bytes32,uint32).notice: Update the VQC-derived trust score for an agent. Called by the router only.

validateAgent(bytes32).notice: ERC-8004: Returns true if the agent is registered and currently active.
